WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region

SELECT d.fiscal_year, sum(r.net_sales) control_net, sum(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) web_control, count(distinct r.store_id) nstores, min(r.business_date) mn, max(r.business_date) mx
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'ret dup same line/date/qty' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, refund_net FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns exceeding sale qty', count(*) FROM (SELECT r.sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY r.sales_line_id, f.quantity HAVING sum(r.quantity_returned) > f.quantity)
UNION ALL SELECT 'regions in dim_store current', count(distinct region) FROM dim_store WHERE is_current
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines in Q3 FY25/26 with ZZ Test or 999', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales lines in Q3 FY24/25 with ZZ Test or 999', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
